patch.value: GH-740: make the documented aggregate SDK barrel complete and continuously derived

GitHub: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/740. The documented @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk compatibility aggregate omits 45 supported exports present on contracts, governance, query, and runtime subpaths. Restore the public contract or explicitly govern exclusions, and derive a CI assertion from the live subpath surface so drift cannot recur.

Every supported non-test export from declared SDK subpaths is reachable from the aggregate barrel or appears in an explicit reviewed exclusion contract with a reason; docs match runtime truth; a derived negative-control gate fails when a subpath-only export is introduced; packed Node and Bun consumers compile representative query, contracts, governance, and runtime imports from the documented aggregate.
The aggregate SDK entrypoint is a truthful compatibility surface
